verdict.rationale: Fly.io docs mention a 'fully-managed Postgres' service (Managed Postgres) but provide no detail on point-in-time recovery, replica configuration, or HA topology in the evidence pack. Community reports concretely contradict reliability of Postgres on Fly, including databases going down with no info (fly-io-comm-2), explicit complaints about 'postgres machines' unreliability (fly-io-comm-4), and Postgres failing to spin up/link during setup (fly-io-comm-18). missing for 10: explicit documentation of PITR, replica setup, HA failover mechanics, and independent confirmation these work as advertised.
